fusions.name: Hutch Kick
fusions.desc: A hind kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Bars Behind
fusions.desc: Drops a line of bars 5 tiles long for 4 seconds. It deals 12 damage to each enemy that crosses it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Slipped Latch
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Close Shave
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
